title: US 183 Land Talks & Legal Strategy
summary:
*   Austin officials held a special, private meeting to discuss confidential city business.
*   A key topic was discussing land acquisition necessary for the future U.S. Highway 183 Expansion Project.
*   Other confidential discussions included legal advice, potential litigation, and personnel matters.
*   No public decisions or votes were made during this closed-door session.
